title: Practice 2: Verbs from nouns and adjectives

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **беседуем** — бесе́довать (imperfective): to converse, to talk. Wiktionary: бесе́да + -овать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **предчу́вствовать** — to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about). Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**предчувствовал** — предчу́вствовать (imperfective): to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about). Wiktionary: предчу́вствие + -овать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **свиде́тельствовать** — to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of). Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**свидетельствовал** — свиде́тельствовать (imperfective): to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of). Wiktionary: свиде́тельство + -овать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about)
to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прису́тствовать — to be present; бесе́довать — to converse, to talk; предчу́вствовать — to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about); свиде́тельствовать — to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of).
**ослаблен** — осла́бить (perfective): to enfeeble, to weaken; to relax, to slacken, to loosen. Wiktionary: о- + сла́бый + -ить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **освобожу** — освободи́ть (perfective): to free, to liberate, to emancipate, to set free; to free (from); to exempt (from); to dismiss; to clear, to empty. Wiktionary: о- + свободный + -и́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: We need to reinforce the roof.
exercises.why: **укрепить** — укрепи́ть (perfective): to strengthen; to consolidate; to fasten. Wiktionary: у- + крепкий + -и́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **понизил** — пони́зить (perfective): to lower, to reduce; (colloquial) to demote. Wiktionary: по- + низкий + -ить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **умне́ть** — to become wiser. Source: Wiktionary, «-еть» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-еть#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: With the years, a fool doesn't become cleverer, but becomes an old fool.
exercises.ru: С возрастом дурак не ___, а становится старым дураком.
exercises.why: **умнеет** — умне́ть (imperfective): to become wiser. Wiktionary: у́мный + -е́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **слабе́ть** — to weaken, to grow weak/feeble, to slack off, to slacken. Source: Wiktionary, «-еть» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-еть#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**слабеет** — слабе́ть (imperfective): to weaken, to grow weak/feeble, to slack off, to slacken. Wiktionary: сла́бый + -е́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to free, to liberate, to emancipate, to set free
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: осла́бить — to enfeeble, to weaken; освободи́ть — to free, to liberate, to emancipate, to set free; утончи́ть — to make (more) subtle; укрепи́ть — to strengthen.
